findings.title: Empty api_key treated as Available
findings.summary: provider_availability_from_config treats Some("") empty api_key as ProviderStatus::Available, falsely tagging misconfigured providers and recommending them in the recall block.

findings.title: Inert retention_cap knob (form-3)
findings.summary: RoutingExperienceStore.retention_cap is hardcoded to DEFAULT_ROUTING_RETENTION_CAP=5000 with no setter or constructor parameter; form-3 severed wire.

findings.title: Empty agent_id in binding silently routes to default agent
findings.summary: When a binding's agent_id is empty, resolve_route routes to DEFAULT_AGENT_ID=main instead of falling through to the unmatched default-path. Indistinguishable from a deliberate 'main' match.

findings.title: OnceLock::set result discarded silently on second recall
findings.summary: build_routing_experience_message uses let _ = attribution.task_emb.set(task_emb.clone()); a second recall silently loses its embedding, breaking D6 record/recall symmetry.

findings.title: identity_links only on configured-bindings path
findings.summary: Zero-config fallback (resolve_session_key_with_agent) ignores identity_links; only the configured-bindings path consults them. Documented but still a real gap.

findings.title: OutcomeObserver reacts only to SessionCompleted
findings.summary: All non-SessionCompleted events are forwarded but produce no routing record; absence of 'recording' logs is indistinguishable from empty-result paths.

findings.title: Main key parser silently re-types main_key=peer|dm|ephemeral
findings.summary: parse_rest excludes peer|dm|ephemeral from the [main_key] arm; a Main key with such a main_key will not round-trip. project_room does not validate against this reservation.

findings.title: SessionKey::task panics on reserved task_type
findings.summary: Library panic on a String input; no Result, no shared is_reserved_task_type helper, docstring says 'must not be' but does not warn of panic.

findings.title: context_tokens/context_window hardcoded to 0
findings.summary: Two schema columns are always written as 0; a future renderer will treat zero as real measurement. Documented but still worst-of-both-worlds.

findings.title: agent_id verbatim vs session_key normalised split
findings.summary: ResolvedRoute.agent_id is the raw config string while session_key uses normalized form; intentional but the contract is comment-only and easy to misread.

findings.title: format_dm_base PerPeer empty-channel branch is legacy-only
findings.summary: The empty-channel PerPeer arm is only reachable through SessionKey::peer (legacy alias); refactoring that removes the alias silently makes the arm unreachable.

findings.title: Vault-only provider mishandled as Unknown
findings.summary: A provider reachable only via vault (no config entry) is rendered as Unknown, which fail-opens the recall block tag. The LLM picks it up and only discovers the misfire on first call.
